payload.core_mechanism_summary: Count frequencies of a[i] - min(i, n-1-i) to find most common base height x>0; answer is n minus that max frequency. Linear scan with hashing.
payload.rationale: Solution uses counting to find optimal symmetric mountain base, not DP or backtracking. Closest candidate subtype is search_backtracking as it implicitly searches over base values, but it's a greedy frequency count.
